breakdown.description: Boundary section contains incompatible boundary condition types (e.g., periodic vs Dirichlet/Neumann).
breakdown.reason: The user's prompt contained contradictory boundary conditions: one periodic and one Dirichlet. The ground truth resolved this by removing the incorrect Dirichlet condition, as the domain is explicitly defined as periodic. The agent's generated specification correctly omits the Dirichlet condition and only mentions implementing periodic boundary conditions, thus resolving the inconsistency.
